Tumor grade was given as a nuclear grade (low, intermediate, or high) for DCIS and modified Bloom-Richardson grade for invasive carcinoma.
Estrogen and progesterone receptor expression was defined as negative for less than 1%, weak for 1% to 10%, and positive for more than 10% tumor nuclei staining.
HER-2/neu status was defined as negative for 0 to 1þ and positive for 3þ membranous tumor staining by immunohistochemistry. In cases of equivocal 2þ staining by immuno-
